name: claude-usage-limits
description: Your Claude Code session, weekly and per-model limits as live bars in a view beside the Claude Code chat, drawn in Claude's own colours from Claude's own numbers.

commands.title: Claude Usage Limits: Take a fresh reading
Claude Usage Limits: Show the panel

claudeUsageLimits.fetch.description: Take live readings with the same call Claude Code makes for /usage, using the login Claude Code already holds. Off shows the reading already on disk.

claudeUsageLimits.pollSeconds.description: Seconds between readings from the usage endpoint.

claudeUsageLimits.showOnStartup.description: Open the panel in the right sidebar when VS Code starts.

claudeUsageLimits.statusBar.description: Also show the percentages in the status bar at the bottom. Off by default: the panel beside the chat is the one place.
